title_as_printed: The solubility of Oxygen (umol kg-1) in mixtures of Na2SO4 + MgSO4, MgCl2 + MgSO4NaCl + Na2SO4, and NaCl + MgCl2 at 25 C.

footnotes_as_printed.a: The measurements were made on solutions in equilibrium with the atmosphere saturated with water vapor.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Separate mixture with different stock solutions.

pressure_note: Solubilities in moist air were corrected to a total pressure of 1 atm from the measured atmospheric pressures (+-1 mbar); 'The measurements were made on solutions in equilibrium with the atmosphere saturated with water vapor.' Small correction for water vapour pressure being constant when correcting to 1 atm was neglected.
gas_basis_evidence: O2 from air; result is the dissolved O2 amount per kg H2O ('we report the solubilities in umol (kg H2O)-1 or molality (m)'), not a gas mole fraction
volume_basis_evidence: 'we report the solubilities in umol (kg H2O)-1 or molality (m)'; solutions were made by volume and converted to molality with density equations (Lo Surdo et al., 1982)
conversion_needs: P is 1 atm total pressure of moist air, not O2 partial pressure; builder needs the O2 mole fraction in dry air and water vapour pressure if partial pressure is wanted
standard_conditions_note: Not applicable (no gas volumes); the paper does not define standard conditions.
notes: Table 6 printed as four blocks (two upper, two lower); this file is block 2 (MgCl2 + MgSO4), 12 rows incl. the printed zero-molality reference row. Last row (1.0774/0.9788/87.4) carries footnote b: separate mixture with different stock solutions; the printed caption runs 'MgCl2 + MgSO4NaCl + Na2SO4' (missing comma).

air_equilibrated.evidence: solution equilibrated with water-vapour-saturated air, corrected to 1 atm total (p.2351); the O2 mole fraction of dry air is not printed in the paper; standard-air value taken from the Garcia and Gordon convention the paper compares with (coordinator precedent, audit 2026-10-02)

quality_remarks: Last row (printed footnote b on m(MgCl2), m(MgSO4) and [O2]) is a separate stock solution.
